items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: I'm up there with short pants... He's the one who wrote the journal, old boy.

ctx.x: And then when the Regal went to sound, I went with Earl. Regal Theater went to sound.
When did you first see General Morton? Hmm? When did you first see General Morton?

I got news for you. My aunt was working at the Eli Number Two, Johnny Rose up on the stand. I'm up there with short pants. See they let me play in there because my aunt was working there. What was Eli Number Two? 35th and State. Was it a club? Yeah, a night spot. A night spot. He mentions it in that record, you know? I know. I don't know. He got it a little mixed up, though. I don't think he ever worked at 31st Street. That's the original Eli. I see. But he worked at 35th Street. And I'm sitting up there in short…
